'''Hapan basalt''' was a type of stone from the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]]. It was used in the construction of ''[[Star Home]]'', the flagship of the [[Hapan]] [[Queen Mother]]s.<ref name="hapan">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040506hapesmain|text=Hapes: Ladies First|int=Hapes: Ladies First}}</ref>
